input.title: Greenline Energy - lead scoring workshop
input.summary: Part 1 of the workshop. Aisha Bello said quarterly planning starts in three weeks. The group agreed to rebuild the lead scoring model before planning starts. Ken Mori is setting up a sandbox portal for testing. Whether scoring covers the partner channel was not decided.
decisions: Rebuild the lead scoring model before quarterly planning starts.

actionItems.task: Send the current scoring rules export to Ken
actionItems.quote: I'll send the current scoring rules export to Ken by Wednesday.

actionItems.task: Set up a sandbox portal for testing
actionItems.quote: I'll set up a sandbox portal for testing the new scoring.

actionItems.task: Share the twenty accounts sales trusts most
actionItems.quote: I will share the list of the twenty accounts sales trusts most.

actionItems.task: Write and circulate the scoring proposal
actionItems.quote: I'll write the scoring proposal and circulate it before November 16.

openQuestions: Does the scoring need to cover the partner channel?

followUp.subject: Lead scoring workshop: next steps
followUp.body:
Hi Aisha and Ken,

Thanks for the workshop. We agreed to rebuild the lead scoring model before your quarterly planning starts.

From our side: the current scoring rules export by Wednesday, and the scoring proposal before November 16.

Still open: whether scoring covers the partner channel.

Best,
Jordan and Casey
